I replied to Tobias in his DM to confirm the change: his standing call with the Marrow Agrisupply team is now Thursdays at 10:45.

I also told him I don't keep a private memory for each person, so the DM itself is the record and I'll look it up there if he asks. He said no action was needed, so I didn't touch his calendar. I offered to set up a recurring event if he wants one.
